column14: For the Mineral Separation Plant, the initial mining lease was granted in 1972. In 1985, a mining lease was executed which was valid upto July 2005. For renewing of mining lease, a G.O. was granted by Govt. of Kerala in the year 2010, for this Block-III covering an area of 88.119 hectares. The total lease area of this block is 88.119 Ha, of this, 85 Ha is in the possession of KMML. This lease area is located in villages of Chavara, Panmana & Vadakumthala of Karunagappally taluk, Kollam District, Kerala State. It is located at 8* 59' 31.76” North. 76* 31' 22.23” East Lat and Long. to 9* 01' 03.53” North, 76* 31' 08.41” East Lat and Long. The mineral sand production capacity from inland mining is proposed to be enhanced from 2,50,000 MT/annum to 6,50,000 MT/ annum. Beach washing accretions are continuously replenished by the sea and about 1,00,000 MT is proposed to be mined by this method, The total ROM would be increased to 7,50,000 MT per annum.
